notes: Re-pinned post-PR #1054 (commit 3322d52da), which changed this directory's src/main.rs (to_units ceil-to-even, not floor-to-even) after the prior pin (source_commit e5539273a, binary_sha256 57fe087e...) was recorded -- the prior pin's build command would still succeed but would rebuild a stale identity, spuriously failing verify_pumpkin_engine.py against a now-correct binary. source_commit is main HEAD at re-pin time; `git diff 3322d52da 5bbf650d47 -- docs/evidence/2026-08-07-pumpkin-engine/` is empty, i.e. no repo changes to this directory between #1054 and HEAD, so pinning to HEAD is equivalent to pinning to #1054 itself. Rebuild determinism re-measured directly at this commit (not assumed from the prior pin, since #1054 changed the source): two `cargo build --release --locked` invocations from this commit's source, into two independent CARGO_TARGET_DIRs (different absolute paths), produced byte-identical output on this rustc/cargo version. Not yet verified across other rustc versions or operating systems; a toolchain change is expected to require re-pinning (rustc_version/cargo_version are recorded precisely so a mismatch there is diagnosable rather than mysterious).
